title: Microsoft Teams: Proximity join support for attendees in Teams events from Teams Rooms on Windows and Android
description: Attendees can take advantage of proximity join with Teams Rooms on Windows and/or Android for fast, effortless connection to nearby room systems during Teams events, such as town halls, webinars, and structured meetings.
